text:
Every value box has a small i beside it.
Point at it with the mouse, or tap it on a phone, to see what the value means in [laymen's](/lˈAmənz/) terms, its unit, and the normal range.

Every map and three D view can open on a full page with its own buttons.
Tap Full page above the map to open it.

The plus and minus buttons zoom in and out.
Hold a button down to keep zooming.
The arrows button shows everything at once.

The app compares the real readings with the prediction and tells you in [laymen's](/lˈAmənz/) terms how well they match.
The map shows the readings, the difference, or a heat map.
Indoors, the grid test shows pass or fail on each floor.
Low-Voltage Principles explains how each system works, in [laymen's](/lˈAmənz/) terms.

When a number is out of range, the box turns red, says what is wrong in [laymen's](/lˈAmənz/) terms, and offers a one-tap fix.
A blank box is never counted as zero.
